name: NGC 5468 (Webb)
blurb: NGC 5468, a face-on spiral galaxy, seen by Webb.
label: n5468-webb
story: We see this spiral face-on, its loose, open arms laid out in full. Its pulsating Cepheid stars, checked against a supernova in the same galaxy, are mileposts for measuring how fast the universe is expanding.

claims.text: NGC 5468 is a spiral galaxy seen face-on with a loose, open spiral pattern
Its Cepheids are milepost markers for the expansion rate
The Cepheid distance was cross-checked with a Type Ia supernova in the galaxy
